#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s_input;
    std::getline(std::cin, s_input);
    for (size_t position = 1; position + 2 < s_input.length(); ++position) {
        if (s_input[position] == 'a' && s_input[position + 1] == 't') {
            s_input = s_input.substr(0, position) + '@' + s_input.substr(position + 2);
            break;
        }

            s_input = s_input.substr(0, k) + '.' + s_input.substr(k + 3);
        }
        ++k;
    }

}
